goal: Implement Phase G Recommendation B only: reduce avoidable execution cost in tests/milestone_run_v1_test.py by reusing an immutable process-local prepared baseline fixture while preserving every existing adversarial scenario, real disposable Git behavior, real local bare-origin fetch/push semantics, provider fakes, causal invariants, and Assurance coverage. The optimization must not change src/milestone_run.py or any product/runtime behavior. Faster but weaker is failure.
acceptance_conditions: Every pre-existing adversarial scenario in tests/milestone_run_v1_test.py still executes; no scenario is deleted, skipped, xfailed, short-circuited, or converted from real Git to a mock.

The reusable baseline fixture is created from the same .gitignore, builder/reviewer prompts, assurance stub, fake test, initial commit, user config, and real local bare origin as the canonical pre-optimization helper.
Each scenario still receives its own disposable worktree and its own disposable bare origin; no mutable Git refs, run state, working-tree bytes, locks, or remote state are shared across scenarios.
Each cloned scenario's origin URL is rebound to that scenario's own bare origin before controller execution.
Real git fetch/push behavior remains exercised. Provider builder/reviewer/test/assurance adapters remain faked exactly as before.
A dedicated isolation regression proves mutation/push in one cloned fixture cannot alter another fixture's local or remote main state.
No src/milestone_run.py, controller, provider, Assurance-runner, workflow, governance, Truth-layer, resume, application, or product/runtime path changes.
No parallelism, test skipping, scenario merging, framework migration, cache-based omission, or Recommendation C fast runner is introduced.
Standalone milestone_run_v1_test.py still passes completely and all existing PASS assertions remain represented.

A post-change local timing observation demonstrates a clear material reduction versus the recent canonical ~299-318 second local observations; timing remains diagnostic and never controls correctness/pass-fail.
Independent Cursor adversarial review of immutable frozen bytes returns SAFE before promotion.
stop_conditions: canonical origin/main differs from baseline_sha before substantive mutation begins
optimization requires changing src/milestone_run.py, scripts/verify_assurance_baseline.py, workflows, or any path outside allowed_paths
any pre-existing adversarial scenario or semantic assertion must be removed, weakened, skipped, or made synthetic to obtain speed
fixture copies cannot prove isolated local and remote Git state
post-change standalone runtime does not materially improve on the same local environment despite the mutation
full canonical Assurance or any required regression fails
review_requirements: MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_CURSOR_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_OF_IMMUTABLE_BYTES; Cursor is reviewer-only and must not edit the candidate. Any mutation after SAFE invalidates the review and requires a new freeze/review.
